sources: Prices: developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing. Context windows: each model's own Cloudflare page (served window). Evidence: independent benchmarks + the fleet's live D1 scoreboard; full review in the Fleet Model Board (PR #9249).

models.name: GLM-4.7-Flash
models.note: The repo mechanic of the 30B class: 59.2% SWE-bench vs qwen3-30b's 22% at the same price. Default pick for reviewer-style ships.

models.name: Qwen3 30B A3B
models.note: Cheapest tokens on the board; strong reasoning, weak agentic coding (22% SWE-bench). Good for ideation ships.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B
models.note: Best speed/reliability balance in its class; cheapest output rate on the board. Third cheap-class family for A/B diversity.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.note: Strongest independent agentic-coding record in class (Terminal-Bench 2.1 82.7; beats its own Pro on nine agent benches). 1M context.

models.name: gpt-oss-120B
models.note: Proven tool-caller and the fleet's repair workhorse; independent code-domain record is mixed, so no longer an authoring default.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.note: 80.6% SWE-bench Verified, 1M context — whole-PR attack surfaces in one window. Cheap at low call volume.

models.name: GLM-5.2
models.note: Strongest open coding model with independent validation (62.1 SWE-bench Pro — beats GPT-5.5). Worth frontier rates only where one judgment is the product.

models.name: gpt-oss-20B
models.note: Refuted as an authoring tier at fleet scale (75% repair failure, #8870). Honored as an explicit opt-down pin only.

models.name: Kimi K2.7 Code
models.note: 1T MoE code specialist; gains are vendor-only benchmarks practitioners dispute. Re-competes when an independent eval lands.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Super 120B
models.note: Strongest agentic tool-reliability profile in class; first candidate for a coordination-heavy ship.

models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 32B
models.note: Code-specialized dense 32B, pre-agentic generation; DeepSeek V4 Flash dominates it at similar blended cost.

models.name: QwQ 32B
models.note: o1-mini-class reasoning specialist; 24k served window limits diff work.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
models.note: Vision + agentic 27B with a big window; $3.20/M output is the class's worst value curve.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill 32B
models.note: The XO synthesis default; $4.88/M output argues against widening it.

models.name: Llama 4 Scout 17B
models.note: Multimodal MoE generalist; no distinguishing coding-agent evidence yet.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B FP8 Fast
models.note: Fast 70B; the 24k served window is the constraint for review work.

models.name: Mistral Small 3.1 24B
models.note: Capable 24B generalist with vision; nothing it beats the adopted cheap class at.

models.name: Gemma SEA-LION v4 27B
models.note: Southeast-Asian-language specialist; the pick when a repo's docs or users live in SEA languages.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B FP8
models.note: Small tier — below the review-quality floor for default duty; honored so cheap experiments meter honestly.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B
models.note: Tiny; classification-grade only.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B
models.note: Tiny; summarization/retrieval-grade only.

models.name: Granite 4.0 H Micro
models.note: Cheapest tokens on the platform with strong function calling for its size; candidate for trivial classification steps.

excluded.reason: Cloudflare can retire deprecated ids at any time — the silent-blank failure mode the honored set exists to prevent.
No published price — an honored-but-unmeterable model rides invisibly.
A content-safety classifier, not a generator; cannot review code.
The #654 phantom-id tombstone; needs one witnessed live call before admission. K2.7-Code covers the family.

Live-probed 2026-08-23: HTTP 403 — Cloudflare requires a per-account Model Agreement ('you must submit the prompt agree') plus an EU-domicile representation before this id will serve. A licensing gate, not a transient error and not something a failover hop clears, so a ship pinned here fails every time. Catalogued as [vision] rather than [text-generation] so admission cannot pick it up again.
